about: Group life, wave 1 (lane SIG-GROUP, 2026-11-20; AnimalDex docs/ark/behaviours-plan.md P5, catalogue theme group_life, 253 rows in docs/ark/signature-behaviours.json). Every row keeps the stored field and the exact sentence it was read from, and either the act the 3D scene plays for it (built; partial: shown without a detail the row names), or why not: existing (the scene already shows it), held (needs a clip, a formation, a record or a prop the scene does not have). `acts` are the tokens of src/ark-scene/group-acts.json (huddle, sentinel:N, gather, lick, chorus:hours, feast, basking, commute, pairs, roost:social), played only by animals actually aboard together in one group (behaviour-group.ts), or `recipe:<template>` (an existing recipe the species lacked: src/ark-scene/group-recipes.json). `lives`: species whose own text has them living in groups though their profile says solitary or pair: the scene groups them round a leader. A row's `line` (the species' own sentence for the live log) is kept only where the 3D act shows exactly what it says; lines naming a place, season, weather or partner species the act does not guarantee are left out (the generic line is said). Made into the three src files by scripts/ark-group-behaviours.mts.
